content:
morgan: Heads up — Python quickstart on the docs is currently broken, multiple 404s and the client example uses the old api_key param. onboarding customers hit this today and the sample app crashes with TypeError. https://docs.redwood.ai/python/quickstart

morgan: Repro: run the sample in the repo, it fails at client init.

ravi: can you paste the snippet and the full error?

morgan: sure, snippet from docs (old):
```python
from redwood import Client
import os

client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
resp = client.generate("Hello")
print(resp.text)
```
Error: TypeError: __init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'api_key'

claire: this started after auth param rename — SDK now expects token=... and there's an AsyncClient. docs generator didn't pick that up when we renamed params. also a bunch of example assets point to /v1/assets/hello.zip which 404s after we moved to /assets/v2/.

sam: opened GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1287 and started a small PR to update quickstart and asset links. will link PR in a sec.

jordan: nice. quick asks: can we add a short async example and a note about typing (AsyncClient) so users don't accidentally use the sync client in async apps? also a tiny e2e test that runs the quickstart in CI would prevent regressions.

morgan: yes please. onboarding flow hit this and it blocked a trial user for an hour. we should also redirect old asset paths to the new ones to avoid immediate breakage. support case 3421 filed.

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1290 (hotfix: quickstart snippet, asset paths, and note about auth). adding tests + typing updates in follow-up.

devex-bot: docs build started for PR 1290 — build logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/5768 (will post status)

morgan: also found a smaller DX bug: the streaming example in the quickstart uses await client.stream(...) but the sync snippet shows .stream() returning an iterator — mismatch. please make both examples consistent and show the recommended async streaming pattern.

sam: proposing new async snippet for the quickstart (will include in PR):
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
import asyncio
import os

async def main():
    client = AsyncClient(token=os.getenv("REDWOOD_TOKEN"))
    # simple generate
    resp = await client.generate("Hello world", max_tokens=50)
    print(resp.text)

    # streaming example (recommended)
    async for chunk in client.stream("Tell me a short joke"):
        print(chunk.text, end="")

asyncio.run(main())
```

ravi: i'll add typing hints to the SDK usage examples (client: AsyncClient) and add a note about mypy/pyright. will also add a stub for .stream() return type to help autocompletion.

claire: add a short paragraph about retry/backoff defaults — some customers expect automatic retries for 5xx and we only retry idempotent calls. quickstart should show how to configure retries: retries=3, backoff_strategy='exponential' or link to the SDK config page.

jordan: will merge the docs hotfix after CI passes. then follow up with e2e test + redirect rule. @sam @ravi ping me when PRs for tests/typing are up. :thumbsup:

morgan: thanks all. can we also add a short note in the onboarding checklist for CSMs so they don't copy-paste deprecated snippets? saved replies are currently pointing at the old quickstart.

docbot: support case 3421 updated: https://support.redwood.ai/cases/3421 — CSM added temp workaround link to PR preview.

sam: updating PR with the async snippet and a brief blurb on auth param names. will include a short redirect rule suggestion for infra.

jordan: great, closing loop once merged.

morgan: thanks — if anyone sees other snippet drift, pls drop them in this thread so we can batch fixes. :pray:
